reconstruction_priority: tactile stop-motion puppet materials (matte polymer clay skin, fine mohair white hair, authentic wire spectacles, tailored wool coat) — AI often replaces with generic 3D CGI or human skin
poetic side-profile composition looking out over negative space across a twilight city — AI tends to center the figure or turn them facing the camera
intricate miniature set details (weathered carved wood balcony railing, orange blanket, glass jars, ceramic mug) — AI often hallucinates modern metal or plastic furniture
delicate dual-temperature lighting (cool dusk slate-blue exterior vs warm 2600K interior window points with genuine optical bokeh) — AI often flattens the lighting into generic single-tone daylight
